name: Virtual★Happy Land
original_name: バーチャル★ハッピーランド
source:
Welcome to the Virtual Happy Land! The "Virtual★Happy Land" is a dreamland in which everyone can forget all the bad things in their life, and become happy. This is a miraculous healing game for all those tired of living in the modern world. Join the residents of this happy dream world, Maid Happine and Goddess Yohane, and find healing today!

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014310/VirtualHappy_Land/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到虚拟快乐乐园！“虚拟★幸福乐园”是一个让每个人都能忘却生活中所有不好的事情，变得幸福的梦想之地。对于那些厌倦了现代世界生活的人来说，这是一款神奇的治愈游戏。加入这个幸福梦想世界的居民——幸福女仆和夜羽女神，今天就来寻找治愈吧！

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014310/VirtualHappy_Land/]Steam[/url]]
